summary: Steep street beside a motorway, with houses 10-15 m away on the kerb side.

best_section.where: east kerb near the top, opposite the red-roofed house

drivers.seclusion: Houses 11-16 m on the kerb side near the top, more homes 20 m across the road; no bush or park cover.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with marked lanes and a few parked cars; kerb room only, no wide verge.
drivers.traffic: Motorway immediately east and a busy junction at the top.
drivers.convention: Residents park along the street; no sign of van-dwelling.

flags: Steep: about 13% mean grade, over the 12% limit
sun_shade: Open with scattered garden trees; afternoon sun from the west.
